method: Remove the stones from fresh cherries and weigh the edible fruit to match the listed quantity before assembling.
Put 50g rolled oats and 150ml semi-skimmed milk into a clean lidded container and stir until all the oats are wet.
Stir in 100g 0% Greek yoghurt until evenly mixed.

Wash and prepare the fruit, removing any stones or inedible peel, then mix in the measured additions: 120g cherries, 1/2 tsp cocoa powder. Stir powder flavourings into the milk mixture so no dry pockets remain.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight. Stir well before eating; the oats should be soft throughout.
Keep chilled and eat within 24 hours of preparation, following any shorter ingredient use-by date. The listed quantities include every topping and side.
